reviews_h2: What people say after we are done

reviews.author: Sarah Shelby
reviews.text: Writing this on behalf of my grandmother who found herself in a bit of a crisis when their rental car had a flat. Bryson City Tire Co truly saved the day. They patched my grandmother’s tire in record time and gave her an incredibly amazing price. They were courteous, efficient and overall good people. Can’t recommend them enough!

reviews.author: Sarah & Brandon Jones
reviews.text: Another shop had damaged my rims and refused to make it right. Bryson City Tire spent well over an hour kindly fixing someone else’s mistakes, then only asked me for $20. I was sure to tip heartily to thank them for doing a wonderful job at such an affordable price. Will be coming here from now on for everything!

reviews.author: marcus westmore
reviews.text: Driven past them many times. But today my truck needed an oil change, tire rotation and a general check up. Stopped in and found out you didn't need an appointment. First come first serve. What a friendly group of folks. No waiting today and they finished the job in about 30 minutes. The mechanics are well trained and thorough. I used to take my truck to the dealership and waited for hours paying an arm and a leg. Here they did it quickly and at a much better price. Glad I found these folks.

reviews.author: John Rider
reviews.text: Best Tire Shop in Bryson City. Arrived in my pickup truck from out of town with a nail in a tire, and a slow air leak. Stopped in for repair, they got me in and pulled the wheel and tire off the truck within a few short minutes. Dylan pulled the nail out, plugged the tire and had me back on my way within a short period of time. In and out wihin 30 minutes. They are extremely friendly and helpful, and the cost was absurdly low. I would have been okay with paying much more, the repair was super inexpensive. Dylan was awesome. Should you need tires or a tire repair and you are anywhere near Bryson City Tires, you should definitely go there. Thank You.

reviews.author: Dave Mangold
reviews.text: A typical tire shop with a well air conditioned waiting area that alows dogs inside. Quick tire repair service and non in stock new tires available next day. Friendly and informative mechanics with a great tire repair price.

reviews.author: Brett Hamrick
reviews.text: This place is great. Stopped in with 2 tires that needed repair when most of the area was shut down due to a snowstorm. They got me fixed up in no time and charged me a really reasonable price. So nice to have good honest people left in the world.

reviews.author: L Cardinal
reviews.text: I called Bryson City Tire today and asked if they do North Carolina vehicle inspections. The man on the phone said they did them. I also asked if I needed an appointment, and he said no. Unfortunately when I arrived there, the guy told me that I would have to wait about 3 hours. It would have been nice if I was told that in the phone.

reviews.author: Michael Harper
reviews.text: Got a screw in my tire at 430 on a Friday. Called and the fit me in before closing. Very kind people. Very friendly and helpful.

reviews.author: Sara New
reviews.text: Sooo we were those people who pulled up 8 MINUTES before they closed because we got a flat tire in the middle of our over 3 hour drive back home, and they did not even hesitate to help us out!! They were professional, EXTREMELY quick to fix the issue and we are now finally headed home! We need more people like the crew here in this world, and we are extremely grateful for them!!

reviews.author: Mary Holzinger
reviews.text: Terrific service! Quick & professional! When a company has been in business since 1961, there's a reason! Awesome work at replacing our brakes on short notice and then we were back to the mountains!! Thanks again!!

reviews.author: Ruth Rish
reviews.text: Had an issue with a slow tire leak while on vacation. Dropped by right before they closed. These guys are just the best. Within a minute they had the tire off. Found a screw. Plugged the leak and we were back on the road. Very reasonable priced as well. Highly recommend!

reviews.author: Shane Rakestraw
reviews.text: Best and most honest tire shop around. We are in Bryson City on vacation thought our brakes needed replacing. The price was very reasonable. They got us in and the owner informed us the brakes didn't need replacing. I would definitely recommend them.

reviews.author: Mariah Derico
reviews.text: Super nice people, quick service! They were really priced well and definitely did not take advantage because i'm a girl

reviews.author: Adam Jennings
reviews.text: Had a slit in my tire sidewall and needed a replacement quick before heading out of town. Bryson City Tire Co was able to get me a fairly new used tire mounted in about 15 minutes for $35. Friendly staff & service, would recommend to anyone in the area!

reviews.author: Traci Huff
reviews.text: Thank you for the excellent service. I stopped in to get some nitrogen put in my tires and the young man was very polite and professional.

reviews.author: Bob Billings
reviews.text: Really good experience with Brent. Super nice guy. Very reasonable price of $20 to rotate my tires. I’ll be back for sure.

reviews.author: John Baird
reviews.text: Great place to do business with! I was on a long trip, stopped in to have them check the tpms system. Quick and friendly service. Family owned.

reviews.author: Shane Docken
reviews.text: Amazing place and the service was great! We live 16 hours away and had a flat along with one other tire that was in bad shape. They were able to get two tires in and go the extra mile for us. They had the tires mounted and changed within 25 minutes. Highly recommend!

reviews.author: John (Johnny)
reviews.text: I am not surprised at all to see excellent reviews for this establishment. Brent went above and beyond with his service with tires and when we had a battery issue Brent sent us to Advanced Auto where we received more excellent customer service. And a thanks to the entire staff at BCTC. If you have lost faith in the human race, visit BCTC....Lol They will help restore it.

reviews.author: Plain Jane
reviews.text: I always take my vehicle here for my state inspection. Recently I noticed a horrible rattling noise and thought it was a rock or something loose. I’d just replaced my brake pads and rotors so I knew it wasn’t that. I went to BC Tire and asked Brent if they could look at, bays were full, they were clearly busy, but right in the parking lot they jacked it up, took off all the tires, put them back on and told me that some of the bolts weren’t screwed on when I had my rotors changed! They just screwed them back on. He didn’t even charge me! They’re always very friendly and efficient and honest!! I recommend them anyone who needs work on their vehicle or just for state inspection! My mom changed her car place and goes to see Brent now!

reviews.author: David Siemens
reviews.text: I needed a state inspection to renew my annual tag. The state mandates both the annual inspections and the fees that are charged for the inspection. So, in that sense one inspection place is as good as another. Unless they uncover "work" that needs to be done to bring your vehicle into compliance. No worry about that at BC Tire Company. These guys are fast, friendly, and just all around good, honest people. I'm going back next week with my wife's car.

reviews.author: Rebecca O. Hedrick-Holcombe
reviews.text: I dropped my van off the night before because I needed an oil change, and something was wrong with my brakes. It was done the next day in no time at all. Brent had saved us before, and I will not go anywhere else for tires and brakes for the rest of my life. His roadside service is way more than reasonable, and shop work was priced along the national averages. Great job, Bryson City Tire Co!

reviews.author: J MS
reviews.text: Brent was great to work with, super straightforward and knowledgable. Knew what tire we needed, was able to order one first thing in the morning and it arrived just after noon. Had our car towed from a high mountain top cabin (by Reservation Auto who were equally awesome). As soon as out car was put down, they had us on a jack and changed the tire. On our way again in not even 30 minutes. What could have taken two days from our vacation was over in just a few hours. Such great and pleasant people. Thanks!

reviews.author: Steve Duncan
reviews.text: Treated me like a friend! Did fast, great work! Excellent hard working, competent employees!! Some others in area snubbed me because I already had the tires. Some used pretend excuses and told me they were backed up. These guys were very busy but were only too happy to help! I don't know know about all the other places..(snobs) but Bryson City tire company has my business for life!!

reviews.author: Sofia Marzan
reviews.text: The staff have always been helpful and super friendly. Quick and easy to work with. I have come to them for 3 years now, almost 4. The yearly inspections are like $13, and they are fast, and they don't try to jerk you around with prices.

reviews.author: Steve Crumley
reviews.text: We full time in our RV and yesterday while we were driving the pickup truck through some tight switchbacks I noticed when I pressed on the brake pedal it made a brief noise and felt odd. This happened a few times, so I called Bryson City Tire this morning (simply based on their wonderful and positive reviews) and explained what was happening. He said to come on down and they will look at it. I got there with in 15 minutes of calling them and after a very short wait for them to get to me, they looked over the brake system and said all was ok. They live up to their great reviews. Everyone was friendly and professional.

reviews.author: Carolyn Williams
reviews.text: Camping at Big Creek and got a flat. Took tire for repairs and had a super experience! Fixed and changed our tire in 10 minute from arrival. Charge was super reasonable, especially compared to rates in our area. Great, friendly employees and polite! Definitely recommend you go there if you need efficient, friendly people who know their trade!!

reviews.author: Tina Miller
reviews.text: I can't say enough positive about my experience with this business. I had gone down for a horse camping trip and James at the campground recommended them upon discovering flat spots on my trailer tires causing it to buck like crazy. They got the tires at a reasonable price, came out to my trailer, took off the old ones and put on the new ones for a very reasonable extra fee for that service. They were amazing b/c I was in a jam, and they did not take advantage of the situation, but were honest and reasonable! Hurray!!!

reviews.author: Josephine Clark
reviews.text: great service, fast and cheap. we’re from out of town and needed a new tire and we were very pleased.

reviews.author: Cary Michael Christie
reviews.text: These guy's are great . And fast. But they do a great job . And the balancing of the tires was right on. Thanks guys. The owner is a very nice guy. They have beaten every one's price. You won't be disappointed

reviews.author: Marisa Burnham
reviews.text: This place is worthy of 6 stars. My husband and I were passing through and noticed a squeaky noise in our tires. Out of an abundance of caution we stopped at Bryson City Tire Co. and asked if anyone would be available to take a look. Brent immediately made himself available. Turns out our brake pads were shot. Brent made a call and replaced the pads within the hour and we were able to continue our road trip with little delay. Brent’s kindness and compassion made our day. I highly recommend anyone in the area in need of tire work to stop here and make sure to say hi to Brent.

reviews.author: Samantha Fletcher
reviews.text: I was only in town for my best friends wedding in an unfamiliar place. When my car lost tire pressure in one side.The people here treated me like I was family. Their outstanding customer service is something that you just don't find anymore. Though they couldn't find a hole in my tire they worked to make sure that my vehicle would be safe to drive especially in the snow. They were also very speedy and informative throughout the process. 10/10 would reccomend to anybody.

reviews.author: Victoria Whorley
reviews.text: We were traveling from Virginia and our brakes needed new pads. They got us in fast and did a great job at a great price. We were so glad they were able to help us. Great folks; great transaction!!

reviews.author: Linda Mooney
reviews.text: Can't say enough good things about this business that we have in our little town. Staff is so polite prices are unbelievably reasonable, they work fast to get you in and out. Highly recommend this business. They will always have our business.

reviews.author: Sarah Steimel
reviews.text: We were traveling from Louisiana on vacation when we started having trouble with our brakes on a mountain drive. We called Brent first thing the next morning and he had us fixed up and back on. the road in 2 hrs. He was very professional and very reasonable. I would highly recommend this company. Bryson City Tire Co. saved the day and our vacation!

reviews.author: Carlos Perez
reviews.text: Popped a tire while I'm in the middle of nowhere and these guys hooked up a hard -to-find size and had me out in no time. Price wasn't bad either for bring so remote. Thanks guys!

reviews.author: Becky Coggins
reviews.text: Have a very nice young man working here. He helped me with a blowout on truck and trailer with no spare, got me back on the rd. I delivered my cattle without any further problems. Thanks you are # ONE

reviews.author: Lynne Young
reviews.text: My son stopped by to get a tire puncture fixed. The customer service was excellent. I found the company, for him, by researching ratings. He expetienced A+ customer service and will definitely recommend you to his friends. He will be back if he ever needs a new tire in the near future.

reviews.author: Evan Turner
reviews.text: Great place. They had to order a couple of odd-sized trailer tire/wheel assemblies for a boat trailer that I was restoring. The tires were there the next day when promised. End price was even a little less than the original quote. Very pleased.

reviews.author: Rob Ressler
reviews.text: Bryson city tire co has done an excellent job on my girlfriends car 3 times and performed an state inspection and put new tires on my mustang. They are fast friendly and the workmanship is excellent. I will only use their services from now on!!!!!

reviews.author: Russ Anderson
reviews.text: Super experience. Were in from out of town and hit something on the highway that punctured my tire. Took it to Bryson City Tire, they patched it, swapped out the spare for the repaired tire for an incredible price. Great service, really fast, would recommend.

reviews.author: Miroslaw Jacek Kowalski
reviews.text: I join the other positive reviews. if you need service and you are in the area, use this workshop. would definitely recommend their professionalism, quality and value. They saved me from traveling to Canada on a car trailer

reviews.author: Deanna Deschenes
reviews.text: My kids are moving from Boston to Florida and stayed a night in Bryson. They noticed a squeal in there tire and stopped in to see what the noise was. Brent took great care of my kids, changed out the front brake pads and had them back on the road in less than 30 min. Thanks so much for your kindness!

reviews.author: TAMMY LAMBERT
reviews.text: Very professional, honest, and trustworthy; and great prices too, I love this place! So very thankful to have found them the last few years, wouldn’t take my vehicle anywhere else.

reviews.author: Mark J. Claxton
reviews.text: I've been a devoted customer for many years. Always great quality work with service after the sale. Owner is always there during biz hrs. running the shop with a personable, hands-on style.

reviews.author: Gabi Beam
reviews.text: These guys are fantastic! The very friendly and they do a great job. Also The prices are super reasonable! I always bring my car here for tire rotation, car inspection, and oil changes!

reviews.author: Karen Bradley
reviews.text: While visiting the area from out of state for a train ride through the mountains, I had a flat tire. I was able to drop it off at 8, make the train, and pick it up at 4. They were extremely helpful. Highly recommend!

reviews.author: Katie M
reviews.text: Went to come get my oil change and I was highly satisfied with not only the service, but the prices as well! They got me in and out in about 15 minutes, outstanding! Will definitely come back!

reviews.author: Mark Hanna
reviews.text: I have been using Bryson City Tire for state inspections and tire replacements for the past few years, and they are a pleasure to deal with. From full name brand tire sets to misc trailer tires, they can get exactly what you need very quickly. Highly recommend!!!

reviews.author: Sophia Seage
reviews.text: Busted a tire while visiting from out of town and needed a repair before making the trip home. First come, first serve, so we just rolled in before heading out and were in and out in under 30 minutes. Pleasant, straightforward, and prompt service - could not recommended more highly.

reviews.author: Rachel Rowe
reviews.text: Brent (the owner) treated me like family fast service and excellent prices. They ordered my 14s and had it ready the very next day. I highly recommend Bryson city tire co.

reviews.author: Christina Brown
reviews.text: I went there to get a flat tire repaired. Before going there, one or two people told me that it wouldn't be fixable and that I would need a new tire. My cost was. $10 and at least three weeks and 600 miles later, the tire is fine.

reviews.author: Tony Edens
reviews.text: Friendly and helpful people. Quickly fixed 2 tire issues I had. Had picked up 2 nails and tires keep going down. Had stopped at another place first who told me it was the weather causing my prolums.

reviews.author: Jensen Peone
reviews.text: Had my fiancé get my tires changed here and the tpms light (tire pressure monitor system) came on right after and so did a b1 light which means oil life, idk if that one has something to do with it or not but these lights came on right after we got the second set of tires in the back put on... so my fiancé went back to ask if they could help since it obviously was their fault and they couldn’t help us. Now we have to spend $300.00 or more, depending on how many sensors they broke, to get the sensor(s) fixed. Which leaves me spending over $300.00 plus the $340.00 i already spent to get my tires changed in the first place. I do not recommend this place, they did something wrong and could not offer a resolution nor did they offer to fix their mistake. This is not right. You would be better off to go to your dealership, where they take ownership of their mistakes and fix them. It’s worth the extra drive.

reviews.author: Bonnie Willcox
reviews.text: Great people. Got me in within 24 hours as they had to get my tires ordered. A satisfied customer, to say the least!

reviews.author: Corinne Ramos
reviews.text: I had a great experience at Bryson City tire. They took me right in to change a flat tire and made sure that I had proper lug nuts for tire because I only had three on tire for safety I would recommend to any one to go there Corinne Tomanek

reviews.author: Jeanette Marceau
reviews.text: Needed a tire patched. Great local company. Also needed large dump truck tires several months ago, they were able to order them in within a few days and their pricing was great.

reviews.author: Randy Gray
reviews.text: Excellent customer service. Friendly staff and quality work. Told us it would probably be an hour before they got to us but waited only 40 mins. They have alot of customers but I see why. It's worth the wait.

reviews.author: Diana Swenson
reviews.text: Replaced a tire stem that went bad and caused my tire to lose air. Very professional, kind, courteous employees. Also very reasonable in price.

reviews.author: pat wade
reviews.text: Visiting BC for the first time. Had a tire going low on us. They were able to take care of us quickly. Thanks! Nice folks!

reviews.author: William Almond
reviews.text: The most friendly 2 men & will go above and beyond to HELP anyone!!! Great prices a real home town garage and tire shop, they'll have my & my family's buisness from now on!!!! Thanks guys, Billy Almond

reviews.author: Bert Rosado
reviews.text: Great service! Out of town and had low tire pressure due to cold. They took it off and found no leaks. Inflated tire and checked all the others. They refused to charge. WOW!!

reviews.author: Connie Miller
reviews.text: Called about oil change. Had 1 car in front of me. And it was a few minutes later, and he had mine on the racks.

reviews.author: Dan Ferren
reviews.text: The best in all catagorie. Four sets of tires over the years. Service is still great, product is still great. I still always shop around but still go back to BRYSON CITY TIRE.

reviews.author: Cullan McNamara
reviews.text: I only needed a check up and an easy valve stem fix, but they did it quickly, and they were very kind and knew what they were doing. I'd highly recommend this place!

reviews.author: Christy Sizemore
reviews.text: RUDE! Don't care attitude, like they are doing you a favor. Left and went to SMOKY MOUNTAIN TIRE! THEY WERE FRIENDLY, FAST AND REASONABLE PRICING!!! Great folks!!!

reviews.author: Cheryl Howard
reviews.text: They took me right in for an oil change & tire rotation. Very friendly & very reasonable price. Will use them again.

reviews.author: Josh Reaves
reviews.text: We had a flat while on vacation. We went to a couple places with no luck until we went here. They were super friendly and helpful. We were in and out in no time. Highly recommended.

reviews.author: Vicky Perez
reviews.text: Wish all tire shops were quick like this one. Great service every time. Will only use another tire shop for emergency only.

reviews.author: Joseph Baron
reviews.text: Came in with a low tire left with a smile. Brent even took a minute to tell me a funny story about one of his new gadgets that honks the car horn. They patched up my tire and off we went... If you're in "Cherokee" looking for "tire" service this is the place to go.

reviews.author: John Ward
reviews.text: They were great ! Had a break line break and they got me worked in and had it fixed in less than 2 hours at a very good price! Highly recommend them.

reviews.author: Josh Engstrand
reviews.text: These guys saved our trip. Quick service and got us back on the road in less than an hour with many vehicles ahead of us. Thank you gentlemen

reviews.author: Amber White
reviews.text: Let's put it this way, if you have a problem at this place its a 99.9% chance that it's you and not them. Love this business and won't take my SUV anywhere else if I can help it.

reviews.author: Natascia Kasso
reviews.text: These gentleman were not only professional but I called late one afternoon and my tires still made it 2 days later and only had to wait about an hour, including 2 cars in front of me getting the service they requested.

reviews.author: Joe Smith
reviews.text: I needed a tire and the owner was able to order this tire that I needed. It was installed quickly and efficiently. Great Price too!

reviews.author: unknowngang
reviews.text: This place has the most kind fellows around. I only waited a few minutes and everything was done. Love this place.

reviews.author: Ruslan Abbasov (LansovTV)
reviews.text: Straight forward, honest. in and out in min. I am in a car business and would definitely recommend these guys!

reviews.author: Janet Martin
reviews.text: We got a flat out by the Appalachian trail. They plugged the tire and had us back on the road quickly.

reviews.author: Dawn Gordon
reviews.text: Sitting down the road with a tire rapidly going flat, we pulled up reviews and this place had stellar ratings and reviews! We limped down the road, pulled in on our last 10 lbs of pressure and within 10 minutes our tire was patched and we were on the road again! Professional, fast service! Highly recommend!

reviews.author: Patrick Goss
reviews.text: Had a tire going down with a nail. They had me in and out in 15 minutes … not a local, but a local woman was there with the same issue and they had her out in 15 minutes also. And very inexpensive. Really appreciated their service!!
